[SWS_CM_00085] Precondition for Event/Field unsubscription
⌈
To avoid dangling
references to
Event
sample data (referred to by a
ara::com::SamplePtr
) which
has not yet been handed back to communication management by the application, it is
required that all
SamplePtr
s provided by
GetNewSamples()
are released (by calling
any of the APIs defined in [SWS_CM_11547], [SWS_CM_11539], [SWS_CM_11540],
or [SWS_CM_11545]) before before calling
Unsubscribe()
. If this precondition is
not met, a violation shall be raised as per [SWS_CORE_00090].
⌋
Note:
Special care needs to be taken when an event receive handle calls
GetNewSam-
ples()
- it might lead to violation if an event is received directly before or at the be-
ginning of the
Unsubscribe()
call.
